note: Not a harness but a runtime: the command is the first user arg, as with generic-openai. NODE_OPTIONS carries --require of the fetch hook written into ctx.runDir, and BUN_OPTIONS carries --preload of the same file because Bun ignores --require inside NODE_OPTIONS (checked against a real bun); which is the only reason this adapter exists — an agent on the Vercel AI SDK reads none of the base-url variables. They are set anyway because one agent may use an SDK default client for one provider and a hardcoded origin for another. harness_versions is null because the thing being pinned would be Node itself, and the hook uses nothing newer than the CLI's own floor.
